subject: Flex transfer playbook — rides, short-term parking, and last-mile windows
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ethan Brooks <ops@goldlinecars.com>, Venue Logistics <events@bayviewhotel.com>, Sasha Ito <sasha@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Flex transfer playbook — rides, short-term parking, and last-mile windows

Team,

We have the Acme on-site workshop on Oct 27–28 (mixed exec + practitioner tracks). I want to lock down the ground plan today so operations has a single reference for arrivals, evening departures, and a short-term parking allocation for sponsors. High level ask:

- Confirm Goldline can provide 6 dedicated sedans (06:30–22:30) plus on-call SUVs for ad-hoc exec runs.
- Provide curb-to-lobby pickup windows for the two arrival flights (AA 1205, UA 3253) and two late-night departures (22:00–23:00 block).
- Reserve 12 short-term sponsor parking spaces at Bayview Hotel for Oct 27 (8am–6pm). We need access passes and a site map.

Please respond with: availability, per-vehicle hourly rate, any surge windows, and a one-line mitigation for inclement weather (backup driver pool or ride-share fallback).

I'll consolidate into the Google sheet (linked below) and send the manifest by EOD.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Ethan Brooks <ops@goldlinecars.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Venue Logistics <events@bayviewhotel.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Flex transfer playbook — rides, short-term parking, and last-mile windows

Karthik —

Thanks for the details. Goldline can cover the fleet you described. Quick answers below:

- Fleet: 6 sedans + 2 SUVs on-call (drivers on standby). We can stage a backup driver pool (additional 2 drivers) for weather or high-concurrency periods.
- Rates: $55/hr per sedan, $75/hr per SUV (includes fuel and standard gratuity). Minimum 3-hour booking per vehicle for airport pickups.
- Pickup windows: we'll hold a 30-minute guaranteed curb window per arrival (30 minutes before scheduled gate arrival to 0 minutes after). For late-night departures we can assign dedicated drivers for a 60-minute window (22:00–23:00) to batch multiple short trips.
- Surge: Peak surcharge of 20% applies between 07:00–09:30 and 16:30–19:00 local; otherwise flat.

I'll attach a preliminary quote and a sample vehicle manifest template. If you want us to manage the short-term sponsor parking check-in (on-foot marshal + printing passes), we can do that for an add-on flat fee of $250.

Attached: goldline_quote.pdf, vehicle_manifest_template.csv

—Ethan
Ethan Brooks
Operations Lead, Goldline Car Services
ops@goldlinecars.com | +1 650-555-0244

Date: 2026-10-12T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Flex transfer playbook — rides, short-term parking, and last-mile windows

Karthik / Marissa —

Two operational notes from the venue (Bayview):

1) They require vendor insurance certs 7 days prior and a contact person for curb marshalling. Events told me to provide a direct cell for the marshal on-site.
2) The sponsor parking area is behind the north loading dock — it can be used for short-term drop/pick; however they need the pass list by Oct 24 and want the passes printed at the venue.

Marissa, can you confirm whether we want Goldline to operate check-in + print passes (Ethan quoted $250) or if we'll print and staff ourselves? We'll need 2 people on the pass desk for 8:00–16:00.

Also, Marcus — can you approve the $250 add-on if printing + staffing is a lift for Ops?

Lauren

Taking this on — attaching the initial vehicle manifest for pickup windows and sponsor pass list. I've aligned passenger names to flights and noted special requirements (carseats, AV drop-offs). Please review the manifest and flag any corrections by 17:00 PT; I will send the final CSV to Goldline and Bayview at 18:00 PT.

Attachment: vehicle_manifest.csv (stub)

Operational clarifications:
- Arrival staging: Goldline, please aim to park drivers at Curbs A/B; Bayview events team, please confirm which door the drivers should use for lobby drop-off to avoid conflicts with hotel valet.
- Walk-ups: we will keep two pooled rides for same-day walk-ups (credit-card hold on file).
- Bad weather plan: if it rains, Goldline to provide covered shuttles (if required) and we will push out a two-minute prep note to guests to expect lobby routing.

I will also add a small column in the sheet for "escort required" for C-levels who need an on-site host.

—Marissa

Got the manifest — thanks. We can confirm the following and will prepare a final PDF manifest and printed driver sheets by Oct 25:

- Confirmed vehicles: 6 sedans (IDs S1–S6), 2 on-call SUVs (U1–U2), backup pool (D1–D2).
- Rate confirmation: sedans $55/hr, SUVs $75/hr; 20% peak surcharge applies as noted.
- Parking/support add-on: we'll handle printing passes and marshaling for $250 (accepted).
- Insurance: attaching Goldline COI; will email the venue a direct cell for on-site marshal (Mike 650-555-0999).

Attached: goldline_quote.pdf, vehicle_manifest_final.csv, goldline_coi.pdf

We will route the final manifest PDF to your shared Drive link and to Bayview events directly. If anything changes after your 18:00 final manifest deadline, please call my line — we will hold a 2-hour grace window to accommodate last-minute edits.

Best — Ethan
